name: exocortex · bluejay report
_comment: scripts/bluejay-run.sh (weekly serendipity news-reader: allowlisted RSS summaries -> claude -p collide, quarantine-only blast radius) POSTs its run summary here. Payload: {status: nothing|finds|violation|failed, day, items, finds, detail, commit}. 'nothing' is a SUCCESSFUL run — the wrapper reports every run so the agent never needs a find to have a deliverable (see vault/30-projects/internet-wanderer.md, Forging 2). This workflow is the RECEIVER, for visibility/history in n8n. Sibling of exocortex-magpie. Import + activate, then the webhook path below is live.
